intro: The Warsong Outrider Update is a military intelligence dispatch penned by a Warsong outrider stationed along the eastern borderlands of Ashenvale. Entrusted to couriers serving the Horde, it provides frontline observations vital for securing the crossing toward Azshara and strengthening the orcish foothold against night elf resistance.

p: Stretching along the eastern road past Splintertree Post toward the ancient ruins of Azshara, the border of Ashenvale remains a volatile frontier. The Warsong Outrider Update compiles tactical sightings, patrol movements, and resource evaluations from the mounted orcish vanguards riding this perimeter. Sent back to Kadrak at the northern watchtower guarding the Barrens border, these field notes grant Horde commanders a clear assessment of enemy troop concentrations and territorial threats lurking beneath the forest canopy.
